tasks.description: Design and implement a notification system that can handle various types of events. The system should be able to send notifications to users in a timely manner. The goal is to keep users informed without overwhelming them with too many notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has an account, when an important event occurs, then the user receives a notification within 1 minute.

tasks.description: Identify important events that should trigger notifications and implement event triggers. These triggers should be able to detect when an important event occurs and send a notification to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given an important event occurs, when the event trigger is activated, then a notification is sent to the user.

tasks.description: Design and create notification templates that can be used to send notifications to users. These templates should be customizable and able to handle different types of events.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification template, when the template is used to send a notification, then the notification is sent with the correct information.

tasks.description: Implement a frequency control mechanism that prevents users from receiving too many notifications. This mechanism should be able to detect when a user is receiving too many notifications and limit the number of notifications sent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is receiving notifications, when the frequency control mechanism is activated, then the number of notifications sent to the user is limited.

tasks.description: Implement a feature that allows users to customize their notification preferences. Users should be able to choose which types of notifications they receive and how often they receive them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when the user updates their notification preferences, then the user receives notifications according to their preferences.

tasks.description: Write tests to ensure that the notification system is working correctly. These tests should cover different scenarios and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification test, when the test is run, then the test passes.

tasks.summary: Migrate existing events to new system
tasks.description: Migrate existing events to the new notification system. This should ensure that users continue to receive notifications for important events.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing event, when the event is migrated to the new system, then the event triggers a notification.
